description:
The Subscriber notify path detects mailbox saturation and sends `:filament_observable_resubscribe` instead of dropping updates (see `gen_server.ex` lines ~366-390). The Cell path in `notify_cell_each/2` (~line 329) currently just calls `send(entry.pid, {:cell_update, sub, new_projected})` unconditionally.

Bring the same saturation check to `notify_cell_each/2`: read `:message_queue_len` via `Process.info/2`, and on saturation skip the send and trigger a Cell-style resubscribe (see T3).

Add a backpressure test analogous to `test/filament/observable/backpressure_test.exs` but for the Cell path.
title: Add backpressure to Cell notify path
